title: Git basics
description: Commits and branches, shown the way Git really stores them. Carries its own "git" pack.
author: visilearn

scenes.source:
scene git.commits "Commits are snapshots"
about "A commit saves your whole project and remembers the commit before it."
use git

commit c1 message="first draft"
branch main
head here label="HEAD"
link here main
link main c1

step "One commit"
  say "A commit is a snapshot of every file at one moment, plus a short message."
  highlight c1
  note c1 "snapshot + message"

step "Committing again"
  ask "When you commit again, what does the new commit point to?" "Nothing" "Its parent, c1" "Every older commit" answer=2
  commit c2 c1 main
  say "The new commit links to its parent, and main moved forward on its own."

step "Your turn"
  say "Make two more commits on main."
  button "git commit" commit c3 c2 main
  button "git commit (again)" commit c4 c3 main
  goal count commit = 4, linked main c4

scene git.branches "Branches are just labels"
about "Creating a branch copies nothing: it adds a label that moves when you commit."
use git

commit c1 message="start"
commit c2 message="add menu"
branch main
head here label="HEAD"
link c1 c2
link here main
link main c2

step "A branch is a label"
  highlight main
  note main "points at c2"

step "Create a branch"
  ask "git branch feature: how much gets copied?" "All the files" "Only the newest commit" "Nothing: it is a new label" answer=3
  branch feature c2

step "Switch and commit"
  switch here feature
  commit f1 c2 feature
  say "Only feature moved forward. main still points at c2."

step "Your turn: merge"
  say "Bring the work from feature back into main."
  hint "A merge commit has two parents: c2 (main) and f1 (feature)."
  button "git merge feature" merge m1 c2 f1 main
  goal linked m1 f1, linked main m1

packs.source:
pack git "Git basics"
about "Commits, branches and merges, the way Git really stores them."
kind commit icon=circle swatch=mustard tier=1 show=message about="A saved snapshot of the whole project. Each commit remembers its parent."
  prop message "what changed"
kind branch icon=tag swatch=mint tier=0 role=label about="A branch is only a movable label that points at one commit."
kind head icon=flag swatch=rose tier=0 role=label about="HEAD marks the branch you are working on right now."
macro commit ID PARENT BRANCH
  add commit ID to PARENT
  point BRANCH ID
  flash ID ok
macro branch NAME AT
  add branch NAME
  point NAME AT
macro switch HEAD_ID BRANCH
  point HEAD_ID BRANCH
macro merge ID INTO FROM BRANCH
  add commit ID to INTO message="merge"
  connect FROM ID
  point BRANCH ID
  flash ID ok
